accessory.behavior.stork.placementTipsSc: The sensor can be mounted horizontally or vertically.
The magnet should be next to the glossy area of the sensor, either to the side or above.
The sensor and magnet must be within 2 cm/0.8 in of each other.
If you use the included adhesive strip to mount the sensor, make sure that you thoroughly clean the surface beforehand.
You can place the sensor’s magnet next to the sensor at up to a 90-degree angle.
Maintain a space of 1.5 cm/0.6 in around the sensor so you can open its battery compartment.
The sensor should always remain inside. If you have a door or window that opens to the outside, place the magnet on that part.
The sensor will blink orange if the battery door is open.
